All five brief lists downloaded with curl from the exact brief URLs (HTTP 200); every list parsed. Faculty pages 1-4 yield 12+12+12+8 = 44 person cards; emeritus list yields 4. Totals 48 = brief.scope.required_person_ids; no person appears on a page but not in the brief, and none in the brief is absent from the pages.

Count reconciliation: the ECE college facet on the listings shows 44 faculty (Faculty filter), 6 staff (Staff filter, verified by a supporting fetch of the ECE staff-tag listing: 2 undergraduate advisors, graduate advisor, grant business services specialist, business services coordinator, ECE technician) and 4 emeritus. 44 + 6 + 4 = 54 = (44 + 6 staff) + 4 emeritus; the 6 difference is staff only and none is a professorial appointment.

Profile pages (optional) fetched for 8 borderline people (Chowdhury, Smith, Nasipuri, Ghasemi, Noras, Oh, Gao, Cal y Mayor Turnbull); all returned HTTP 200 and agreed with the list titles. No profile fetch failed.

No officially announced incoming professors appear on the enumerated official lists, so no incoming records or start dates are asserted; effective_from_json is null for all 48 records. No outside search for announcements was performed.

Michael Smith is the closest call: the "Affiliated Faculty" designation sits on his ECE directory entry without naming ECE in the same string. Decided included affiliate_professor; flagged as a decision, not an ambiguity, because the ECE listing carries the affiliated designation and there is no conflicting official statement.
